edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded into _transfer through transfer/transferFrom without access restriction.
manualswap authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender to _feeAddrWallet1.
block.timestamp is written into the cooldown mapping, making buy gating timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is used inside _transfer to gate cooldown logic.
Stored cooldown timestamp controls whether a buy transfer is allowed.

onlyOwner gates blacklistBots which writes the bot blacklist.
onlyOwner gates removeStrictTxLimit which resets the max transaction amount.
onlyOwner gates delBot which clears blacklist entries.
onlyOwner gates setCooldownEnabled which toggles cooldownEnabled.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
_transfer delegates the accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and sender is not the pair.
_transfer overwrites _feeAddr1 before computing values.
_transfer overwrites _feeAddr2 before computing values.
_transfer reads the bot blacklist to restrict transfers.
_transfer reads fee-exclusion status to skip cooldown and swap logic.
_transfer enforces the maximum transaction amount on buys.
_transfer reads cooldownEnabled before applying cooldown checks.
_transfer reads swapEnabled to decide on automatic fee swapping.
_tokenTransfer routes accounting to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard fetches r/t values from _getValues.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances in _rOwned using SafeMath.
_transferStandard forwards the team fee to _takeTeam.
_transferStandard forwards the reflection fee to _reflectFee.
_takeTeam adds the reflection share of team fees to the contract reflection balance.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the reflection fee.
_reflectFee accumulates _tFeeTotal.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token value breakdown.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection value breakdown.
_getValues obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_getTValues consumes _feeAddr1 as the tax percentage.
_getTValues consumes _feeAddr2 as the team percentage.
_getRate derives the rate from _getCurrentSupply.
_getRate divides the reflection supply stored in _rTotal.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal to compute supplies.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.

transfer forwards to _transfer.
transferFrom performs the transfer through _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the allowance through _approve.

balanceOf converts reflections via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection validates against _rTotal before dividing.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the whole contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with the whole contract ETH balance.

delBot clears a blacklist flag in the bots mapping.
removeStrictTxLimit overwrites _maxTxAmount.
setCooldownEnabled writes cooldownEnabled.

openTrading calls the factory createPair external function.
openTrading approves the router for max uint on the pair token.

sendETHToFee pays half the ETH to _feeAddrWallet2.

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only exists to supply the source address of _transfer and carries no independent semantics.
The to parameter is consumed only by _transfer destination accounting.
The amount parameter is validated and used exclusively inside _transfer.
tokenAmount is the sole input of the swap routine and should collapse into it.
amount parameterizes the fee split and ETH transfer performed by sendETHToFee.
bots_ is iterated and written to state only within blacklistBots.
notbot is used only to clear the bots mapping entry in delBot.
onoff is directly assigned to cooldownEnabled inside setCooldownEnabled.
tAmount is the input amount decomposed into r/t values by _transferStandard.
The local is only a snapshot passed straight into swapTokensForEth.
The local is only a snapshot passed straight into sendETHToFee.
The loop index exists only for the iteration implemented in blacklistBots.
